﻿﻿─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

This mod adds a random collection of plushies because honestly, cute plushies are lacking on this site!
I can't express enough how random these will be lolo.
I have plans for things like FFXIV, Japanese inspired, League of Legends, Pokemon, just simply if I want it in the game, I'mma make it!
Let me know if there is a recolor or variation you'd like me to add like for example if I have a black fox plush but you want it as a blue fox, just go ahead and leave a post or PM me :3
I will even accept [url=https://kitsumegudesu.carrd.co/]commissions[/url]﻿ for custom ones you want added to the pack too!
I hope you guys enjoy them ♥

﻿﻿─── ⋆｡ﾟ☁︎｡⋆｡ ﾟ☾ ﾟ｡⋆ ───

Compatible with 1.6
﻿Needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿
『[b]Replaces the Lg. Junimo Plush and Lg. Futan Bear[/b]』
Not required but I absolutely recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url]﻿ to enjoy this mod to the fullest.
This is my 4th mod so I'm starting to get the hang of it but of course as always, I am open to advice, suggestions, fixes, translations, or anything else!
I have not uploaded this mod anywhere else, so if you see it elsewhere it's been snagged without my permission!
I'm experimenting with different brushes, colors, and techniques so the plushies might end up looking differently from each other but they are all 100% my artwork :3
